artworks.title: Politician
artworks.artist: John Keyse Sherwin after William Hogarth
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated in profile view in a chair. Their facial features are exaggerated, with a pronounced nose and chin. They have long, curly hair and are wearing a wide-brimmed hat. The person is wearing a long coat, knee-length trousers, stockings, and shoes with buckles. They are holding a paper and smoking a pipe. Nearby is a table with a candlestick and papers. The background is plain and crosshatched.

artworks.title: The Battle of the Pictures
artworks.description: This is a drawing with various pictures floating and placed near a building. Several pictures are propped by sticks. The drawing depicts an imaginative scene where various artworks are scattered around. Some appear to hover or fly out of a doorway of a pyramid-shaped structure with a weather vane. The images within the drawing include allegorical and narrative scenes, with mythological and historical references. In the foreground, there is a series of frames lined up domino-style along a path. Near the bottom, a paper is labeled "The Battle of the Pictures." There is also text along the top that indicates an association with the sale of Hogarth's pictures. The composition is rich with detail and uses line work to create depth and texture.

artworks.title: Time Smoking a Picture
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure beside an easel and a pot of varnish. The image features a skeletal figure with wings seated at an easel, engaged with a painting or canvas. To the side is a large urn labeled "VARNISH" and at the figure's feet rests a severed head and a torso. The painting on the easel depicts a cloud or smoke with amorphous shapes. Above the assembly, a ladder is seen. An inscription reads "As Statues moulder into Worth." The style of the drawing is illustrative and detailed, using a clear line technique reminiscent of etchings.

artworks.title: Tailpiece, or The Bathos
artworks.description: The image consists of a variety of shapes and lines creating a detailed composition. In the center is an abstract form resembling a reclining figure with wings, surrounded by objects like scrolls, an axe, and tools. To the right, there is a leaning wooden structure and a twisting tree branch. Above, round cloud shapes with a descending parachuting figure are depicted. On the ground are broken columns, an open book, and scattered painter's palettes. The scene blends familiar objects in an abstract and fantastical way.

artworks.title: Girolamo da Siena
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.4 x 15.7 cm (8 13/16 x 6 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body in a profile view, facing to the right. He is positioned with his head turned to the side, displaying his facial features prominently. The man has a distinct facial structure featuring a prominent nose and a textured beard. His hair is curly and voluminous, covering his head fully. He is depicted wearing a draped garment that covers his shoulders and chest, with the texture of the fabric rendered in intricate detail. His hand is raised to his chest, and his fingers are elegantly positioned. There is no visible jewelry or objects he is holding. The background is plain with some artistic shading, and there is text present in the image that identifies the person.

artworks.title: Kunz von der Rosen
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 29.4 x 21.5 cm (11 9/16 x 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with his hands on his hips. He has a strong expression with thick, slightly curled hair under a decorated cap. He wears a quilted garment with a thorn-like pattern, patterned pants, and a belt holding a sword or dagger. The background features an engraved cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nativity scene. The image shows a baby lying in a basket, surrounded by figures in a stone-arched setting. The figures are kneeling and looking down at the baby, with one holding the baby’s swaddling cloth. In the background, through the arched opening, there are pastoral elements like trees and hills, along with additional figures in the distance. The composition includes textures of the stone, clothing, and wood, all rendered in intricate line work.

artworks.title: The Beggars
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in a scene. The central figure is seated on a rock, wearing a long robe and a round cap. Beside them, a second figure is seated wearing a long dress and a headscarf. Both figures appear to be resting in an outdoor setting, surrounded by rocks and sparse grass. In front of them, a standing figure leans on a staff, offering a shallow bowl. The background shows a barren tree with a hanging sign, and the horizon line is visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Coat of Arms of the Passion
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 17.2 × 12.2 cm (6 3/4 × 4 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing that features a central object resembling a crown or helmet with elaborate scrollwork. Flanking the central object are a saintly figure holding a cross-topped staff on the left and a veiled figure on the right, both wearing halos. In the foreground are animal figures with wings and halos, potentially symbolizing the Four Evangelists, including a winged ox, lion, and eagle. A lamb and a cup are at the bottom center. In the background, there are flowing scrolls with depictions of faces, and at the top, a hand in a blessing gesture emerges from a circular disc. The drawing is intricately designed with delicate line work typical of the late Gothic to early Renaissance periods.

artworks.title: Place de Louis XV
artworks.description: The image displays a bird's-eye view of a grand city square bustling with activity. The horizon is high in the composition, aligning with a dense line of trees in the distance, and the sky has light, wispy clouds and a few birds. The scene is shown in a monochromatic palette, emphasizing detailed linework for depth. In the foreground, there are elegantly dressed figures and horse-drawn carriages on a balustraded terrace. Past this terrace is a grand statue in the middle of an expansive space. The background features distinguished buildings with architectural details shown through precise etching. The artwork conveys vibrancy and elegance, capturing urban life with meticulous detail.

artworks.title: Bathers Wrestling (Baigneuses luttants)
artworks.description: The image shows four figures and a background of dense foliage. The figures are in motion and appear to interact with each other. They appear to be standing in shallow water. The facial features are lightly sketched and the figures are undressed. One additional figure is seated on the ground to the right. The background consists of trees and leaves depicted in an impressionistic style, with sunlight filtering through.

artworks.title: Calavera of Francisco Madero, from Calavera Maderista
artworks.description: Printed with black lines on cream-white paper, a skeleton carrying a bottle and wearing a hat, striped scarf, pants, and sandals walks to our left in this vertical etching. Filling the composition, the skeleton has a walrus handlebar mustache and a goatee. His straw hat has a wide brim and a pointed crown. His scarf drapes over his right shoulder, farther from us. The skeleton holds the scarf in his right hand and an oversized black bottle with a cork in his left hand. The bottle has lettering on the label to read “AGUAR” and “DE PAR.” A few vertical lines around his sandals suggest grass.

artworks.title: The Third Oriental Head
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn and Studio of Rembrandt van Rijn after Jan Lievens
artworks.description: The image is an etching portraying the upper body of a person in profile, facing right. The person is seated and wrapped in rich fabrics. They wear a detailed turban with a feather. The face is partially hidden by fabric folds. The clothing is ornate. The background is minimal with some lines and scribbles. In the upper left corner, there is a signature that reads "Rembrandt f. 1635".

artworks.title: Ruins of the Abbey of Rijnsburg: Small Version
artworks.medium: etching printed in black on linen (prepared with ground) and hand-colored with blue watercolor
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 10 x 17.5 cm (3 15/16 x 6 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an old, deteriorating architectural structure surrounded by foliage. The perspective is at eye level, displaying the facade and side of the building with arched entries and rectangular windows. The horizon is not clearly visible due to the structures in the foreground. The sky in the upper portion of the image is slightly visible. The painting style features detailed stippling and cross-hatching techniques creating texture. The color palette includes shades of gray, brown, and black. Vines and bushes encroach around the ruins, with the structures extending into the overgrown landscape beyond.

artworks.title: Vue de la foire de Beson (The Fair at Bezons)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fair scene. The drawing shows a fairground with carriages, people, and animals. In the foreground, two draft horses pull a carriage filled with passengers. Another carriage is seen behind with several figures around it. There are trees and open tents in the background, indicating an outdoor setting. The drawing is detailed, capturing the lively atmosphere of the fair.

artworks.title: Title Page for "Nouvelles inventions de Cartouches"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate cartouche featuring decorative elements. The cartouche displays text surrounded by a heavily adorned frame with two stylized creatures on either side and elaborate scrolling leaves or acanthus motifs. Above the cartouche, there is a helmet. The text within the cartouche appears to be an announcement or title in French, stating it is from 1647, with references to Paris. The intricate details and use of line work give it a sense of classical richness and opulence.

artworks.title: Cartouche Supported by Triton and Siren
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate frame decorated with mythical creatures. The frame features two figures on each side: one with curly hair and leafy adornments, and the other in a flowing pose. At the top, two intertwined mythological animal heads meet at the center, with their bodies winding down the frame's sides. The center of the frame is empty. Intricate details, including scrolling elements and swirling motifs, enhance the design's baroque style.

artworks.title: Cartouche with Ducks and Dogs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative frame with swans. The drawing depicts an oval-shaped frame composed of elaborate swirling feathers, around which several swans are entwined. The swans are positioned gracefully, with their long necks curved elegantly around the frame. The intricate detailing of the feathers and the fluid lines create a sense of movement and natural beauty, adding an ornamental quality to the design. The lower portion of the composition features swans resting on what appears to be the water's surface, completing the richly textured and harmonious scene.

artworks.title: Cartouche in the Form of a Flayed Tiger Supported by Centaurs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate emblem featuring mythical creatures. It depicts two centaur-like creatures on either side of a central shield-like form adorned with flowing, ornate patterns resembling feathers or fur. Each creature has the upper body of a human and a lower body resembling that of a horse or goat. They are standing on their hind legs and appear to be holding up the central shield with their raised arms. The drawing is detailed with fine lines and textures.

artworks.title: Cartouche in the Form of a Drape Suspended from a Cypress Flanked by Skeletons
artworks.description: The image displays an intricate design with curved lines and shapes within an oval frame. Skeletal figures at the edges hold branches reaching towards the center, resembling trees supporting draped fabric. The central drapery resembles a hanging curtain or fabric banner, with detailed lines mimicking folds. The symmetrical arrangement creates a balanced and mysterious appearance, evoking themes of nature and decay.

artworks.title: Cartouche Suspended from Corpses
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornately decorated frame. The frame features intricate detailing with draped fabric and two skull-like masks at the top. The masks have elongated features and a grotesque appearance. Scrolling decorations and embellishments are seen, including what looks like a scroll and tassel on the left. At the bottom center, there is a blank cartouche with swirling decorative elements. The drawing has detailed linework to emphasize texture and depth.

artworks.title: Cartouche with Eagles and Two Infants  Holding a Crown
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate coat of arms or emblem design. The drawing features a central shield with elaborate scrollwork and decorative elements surrounding it. At the top of the shield, two cherub-like figures are depicted, each holding a semicircular object resembling a basin or platter. The figures are positioned symmetrically on either side of the central emblem, gazing towards each other. Flanking the shield are large, feathered wings, giving the appearance of a grand, mythical crest. The overall design is composed of complex lines and curves, with detailed shading to give depth and texture.

artworks.title: Cartouche with Rams and Infant Satyrs
artworks.description: This drawing features a decorative emblem with two cherubs. The cherubs sit on top of an ornate, swirling form, with their bodies positioned symmetrically. They rest their arms on an empty escutcheon or shield-like shape. Above the cherubs, there is a halo-like ring, while complex, flowing designs extend beneath them, resembling feathers and waves. The artwork includes decorative elements such as tassels and scrolls, enhancing the intricate detailing. The bottom of the drawing is inscribed with "S. Della Bella fecit cum Privilegio Regis.”

artworks.title: Cartouche with Apollo and Pan
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental cartouche. The image features an ornamental frame with elaborate foliage designs and scrollwork. There are figures on each side of the cartouche entwined with the foliage. The centerpiece of the cartouche is left open. The style of the foliage and figures is detailed, suggesting a Baroque influence.
